recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a later work-group decision changes profile derivation semantics or identifies a specific tooling/source gap.
issue_request: FHIR-7575 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core profiling issue from the 2015 May ballot asking the profiling page to state that profiles can be profiled, including realm or constrainable Patient profiles reused by downstream IGs, and that this should work for resource and system profiles.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 6463. Git commit bef18bce7b1086b415f28671b4a107a22ce2bf8c, with git-svn-id build@6463, changed source/profiling.html to say a constraint StructureDefinition may specify restrictions on a resource or datatype or add constraints on an existing profile.
additional_context: Current profiling.html preserves the profile-on-profile statement and adds cardinality guidance for profiles constraining other profiles. Current StructureDefinition source uses baseDefinition targeting another StructureDefinition plus derivation=constraint to represent derived constraints. Related FHIR-3872 supports the same capability at the tooling/spreadsheet level but was broader than this seed's narrative audit.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no current source change is required.

related_jiras.note: Published issue asking for tooling support to base one profile on another profile; it supports the same capability but was not separately decided here.
